description:
A truly exceptional three-bedroom duplex penthouse, offering luxurious living, spectacular views across Southampton and an impressive selection of private outdoor spaces. A must-see property for those seeking something special.

The upper floor is centred around a stunning open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, flooded with natural light through impressive floor-to-ceiling windows. The space enjoys a wonderful sense of grandeur and opens directly onto a wraparound balcony, providing far-reaching views across Southampton and creating the perfect setting for entertaining or simply enjoying the outlook.

The contemporary kitchen is finished to a high standard and benefits from a range of high-end integrated appliances, combining style and functionality.

One of the property's standout features is the elevated private roof terrace, which enjoys excellent levels of sunshine and provides a superb private retreat — ideal for relaxing, entertaining or enjoying the views.

Downstairs, the property offers three generously proportioned double bedrooms, providing excellent accommodation for families, guests or those requiring additional space.

The impressive principal bedroom benefits from an attractive circular bay window, creating an ideal space for a home office or dressing area. The room also features a walk-in dressing room and a spacious, modern en-suite shower room.

Bedroom two is another well-proportioned double bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a stylish en-suite shower room, while bedroom three is also a generous double with built-in wardrobes and is served by the modern family shower room.

Further benefits include a separate utility room, adding practicality and convenience to the property.

Externally, the property comes with one allocated undercroft parking space,

Charter House is ideally situated on Canute Road, close to Southampton city centre and the vibrant waterfront. The property is within easy reach of Southampton Central railway station, Westquay Shopping Centre, Southampton's extensive range of restaurants, bars and cafés, and the city's business and leisure amenities.

The nearby waterfront provides attractive walks and access to Southampton's marina and harbour, while excellent road links provide convenient access to the M3, M27 and surrounding areas. Southampton Airport is also easily accessible by road and rail.

The location offers an excellent combination of city-centre convenience and waterfront living, making it particularly well suited to professionals, commuters and those looking to enjoy everything Southampton has to offer.
